程序包 org.bukkit.plugin

类 PluginDescriptionFile

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.plugin.PluginDescriptionFile
public final class PluginDescriptionFile extends Object
This type is the runtime-container for the information in the plugin.yml. All plugins must have a respective plugin.yml. For plugins written in java using the standard plugin loader, this file must be in the root of the jar file. 此类型是 plugin.yml 中信息的运行时容器。所有插件都必须有相应的 plugin.yml。对于使用标准插件加载器的 Java 插件，此文件必须位于 jar 文件的根目录。

When Bukkit loads a plugin, it needs to know some basic information about it. It reads this information from a YAML file, 'plugin.yml'. This file consists of a set of attributes, each defined on a new line and with no indentation. 当 Bukkit 加载一个插件时，它需要了解该插件的一些基本信息。它从一个 YAML 文件 'plugin.yml' 中读取这些信息。该文件由一组属性组成，每个属性独占一行且不带缩进。

Every (almost* every) method corresponds with a specific entry in the plugin.yml. These are the required entries for every plugin.yml: 每个（几乎*是每个）方法都对应 plugin.yml 中的一个特定条目。以下是每个 plugin.yml 的必需条目：

  • getName() - name
  • getVersion() - version
  • getMain() - main

Failing to include any of these items will throw an exception and cause the server to ignore your plugin. 缺少其中任何一项都将抛出异常，并导致服务器忽略你的插件。

This is a list of the possible yaml keys, with specific details included in the respective method documentations: 以下是可能的 yaml 键列表，具体细节包含在相应方法的文档中：

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * 插件将注册的已定义权限的默认状态 *
The description of the plugin.yml layout
Node Method Summary
name getName() The unique name of plugin插件的唯一名称
version getVersion() A plugin revision identifier插件的修订版本标识
main getMain() The plugin's initial class file插件的初始类文件
author
authors		 getAuthors() The plugin contributors插件的贡献者
description getDescription() Human readable plugin summary人类可读的插件摘要
website getWebsite() The URL to the plugin's site插件网站的 URL
prefix getPrefix() The token to prefix plugin log entries为插件日志条目添加前缀的令牌
database isDatabaseEnabled() Indicator to enable database support是否启用数据库支持的指示
load getLoad() The phase of server-startup this plugin will load during该插件将在服务器启动的哪个阶段加载
depend getDepend() Other required plugins其他所需的插件
softdepend getSoftDepend() Other plugins that add functionality其他附加功能的插件
loadbefore getLoadBefore() The inverse softdepend反向的 softdepend
commands getCommands() The commands the plugin will register插件将注册的命令
permissions getPermissions() The permissions the plugin will register插件将注册的权限
default-permission getPermissionDefault() The default default permission state for defined permissions the plugin will register
awareness getAwareness() The concepts that the plugin acknowledges插件所知晓的概念

A plugin.yml example:

name: Inferno
version: 1.4.1
description: This plugin is so 31337. You can set yourself on fire.
# We could place every author in the authors list, but chose not to for illustrative purposes
# Also, having an author distinguishes that person as the project lead, and ensures their
# name is displayed first
author: CaptainInflamo
authors: [Cogito, verrier, EvilSeph]
website: http://www.curse.com/server-mods/minecraft/myplugin

main: com.captaininflamo.bukkit.inferno.Inferno
database: false
depend: [NewFire, FlameWire]

commands:
  flagrate:
    description: Set yourself on fire.
    aliases: [combust_me, combustMe]
    permission: inferno.flagrate
    usage: Syntax error! Simply type /<command> to ignite yourself.
  burningdeaths:
    description: List how many times you have died by fire.
    aliases: [burning_deaths, burningDeaths]
    permission: inferno.burningdeaths
    usage: |
      /<command> [player]
      Example: /<command> - see how many times you have burned to death
      Example: /<command> CaptainIce - see how many times CaptainIce has burned to death

permissions:
  inferno.*:
    description: Gives access to all Inferno commands
    children:
      inferno.flagrate: true
      inferno.burningdeaths: true
      inferno.burningdeaths.others: true
  inferno.flagrate:
    description: Allows you to ignite yourself
    default: true
  inferno.burningdeaths:
    description: Allows you to see how many times you have burned to death
    default: true
  inferno.burningdeaths.others:
    description: Allows you to see how many times others have burned to death
    default: op
    children:
      inferno.burningdeaths: true

  • 方法详细资料

    • getName

      public String getName()
      Gives the name of the plugin. This name is a unique identifier for plugins. 给出插件的名称。此名称是插件的唯一标识符。
      • Must consist of all alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphon, and period (a-z,A-Z,0-9, _.-). Any other character will cause the plugin.yml to fail loading. 只能由字母数字字符、下划线、连字符和句点组成（a-z、A-Z、0-9、_.-）。任何其他字符都会导致 plugin.yml 加载失败。
      • Used to determine the name of the plugin's data folder. Data folders are placed in the ./plugins/ directory by default, but this behavior should not be relied on. Plugin.getDataFolder() should be used to reference the data folder. 用于确定插件数据文件夹的名称。数据文件夹默认位于 ./plugins/ 目录下，但不应依赖此行为。应使用 Plugin.getDataFolder() 来引用数据文件夹。
      • It is good practice to name your jar the same as this, for example 'MyPlugin.jar'. 建议将你的 jar 命名得与此相同，例如 'MyPlugin.jar'。
      • Case sensitive. 区分大小写。
      • The is the token referenced in getDepend(), getSoftDepend(), and getLoadBefore(). 这就是 getDepend()、getSoftDepend() 和 getLoadBefore() 中所引用的令牌。
      • Using spaces in the plugin's name is deprecated. 不推荐在插件名称中使用空格。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named name. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 name。

      Example:

      name: MyPlugin
      返回:
      the name of the plugin 插件的名称

    • getVersion

      public String getVersion()
      Gives the version of the plugin. 给出插件的版本。
      • Version is an arbitrary string, however the most common format is MajorRelease.MinorRelease.Build (eg: 1.4.1). 版本是任意字符串，但最常见的格式是 MajorRelease.MinorRelease.Build（例如 1.4.1）。
      • Typically you will increment this every time you release a new feature or bug fix. 通常每当你发布新功能或错误修复时都应递增此版本。
      • Displayed when a user types /version PluginName 当用户输入 /version PluginName 时显示

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named version. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 version。

      Example:

      version: 1.4.1
      返回:
      the version of the plugin 插件的版本

    • getMain

      public String getMain()
      Gives the fully qualified name of the main class for a plugin. The format should follow the ClassLoader.loadClass(String) syntax to successfully be resolved at runtime. For most plugins, this is the class that extends JavaPlugin. 给出插件主类的全限定名。其格式应遵循 ClassLoader.loadClass(String) 语法，以便在运行时成功解析。对大多数插件而言，这就是继承 JavaPlugin 的类。
      • This must contain the full namespace including the class file itself. 必须包含完整的命名空间，包括类文件本身。
      • If your namespace is org.bukkit.plugin, and your class file is called MyPlugin then this must be org.bukkit.plugin.MyPlugin 如果你的命名空间是 org.bukkit.plugin，而你的类文件名为 MyPlugin，那么此项必须为 org.bukkit.plugin.MyPlugin
      • No plugin can use org.bukkit. as a base package for any class, including the main class. 任何插件都不能将 org.bukkit. 用作任何类（包括主类）的基础包。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named main. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 main。

      Example: 

      main: org.bukkit.plugin.MyPlugin
      返回:
      the fully qualified main class for the plugin 该插件的全限定主类

    • getDescription

      public String getDescription()
      Gives a human-friendly description of the functionality the plugin provides. 给出对插件所提供功能的友好描述。
      • The description can have multiple lines. 描述可以有多行。
      • Displayed when a user types /version PluginName 当用户输入 /version PluginName 时显示

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named description. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 description。

      Example: 

      description: This plugin is so 31337. You can set yourself on fire.
      返回:
      description of this plugin, or null if not specified 此插件的描述，若未指定则为 null

    • getLoad

      public PluginLoadOrder getLoad()
      Gives the phase of server startup that the plugin should be loaded. 给出插件应被加载的服务器启动阶段。
      • Possible values are in PluginLoadOrder. 可能的取值见 PluginLoadOrder。
      • Defaults to PluginLoadOrder.POSTWORLD. 默认为 PluginLoadOrder.POSTWORLD。
      • Certain caveats apply to each phase. 每个阶段都有一些注意事项。
      • When different, getDepend(), getSoftDepend(), and getLoadBefore() become relative in order loaded per-phase. If a plugin loads at STARTUP, but a dependency loads at POSTWORLD, the dependency will not be loaded before the plugin is loaded. 当不同时，getDepend()、getSoftDepend() 和 getLoadBefore() 将按各阶段的加载顺序相对化。如果插件在 STARTUP 加载，而其某个依赖在 POSTWORLD 加载，则该依赖不会在此插件加载之前被加载。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named load. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 load。

      Example:

      load: STARTUP
      返回:
      the phase when the plugin should be loaded 插件应被加载的阶段

    • getAuthors

      public List<String> getAuthors()
      Gives the list of authors for the plugin. 给出插件的作者列表。
      • Gives credit to the developer. 为开发者署名。
      • Used in some server error messages to provide helpful feedback on who to contact when an error occurs. 用于在某些服务器错误消息中提供有用的反馈，说明发生错误时应联系谁。
      • A bukkit.org forum handle or email address is recommended. 建议使用 bukkit.org 论坛 ID 或电子邮件地址。
      • Is displayed when a user types /version PluginName 当用户输入 /version PluginName 时显示
      • authors must be in YAML list format. * authors 必须为 YAML 列表格式。

      In the plugin.yml, this has two entries, author and authors. 在 plugin.yml 中，此项有两个条目：author 和 authors。

      Single author example: 

      author: CaptainInflamo
      Multiple author example: 
      authors: [Cogito, verrier, EvilSeph]
      When both are specified, author will be the first entry in the list, so this example: 
      author: Grum
authors:
- feildmaster
- amaranth
      Is equivilant to this example: 
      authors: [Grum, feildmaster, aramanth]
      返回:
      an immutable list of the plugin's authors 插件作者的不可变列表

      • Displayed when a user types /version PluginName 当用户输入 /version PluginName 时显示

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named website. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 website。

      Example: 

      website: http://www.curse.com/server-mods/minecraft/myplugin
      返回:
      description of this plugin, or null if not specified 此插件的网站，若未指定则为 null（原文如此，此处描述为复制错误）

    • getDepend

      public List<String> getDepend()
      Gives a list of other plugins that the plugin requires. 给出此插件所需的其他插件列表。
      • Use the value in the getName() of the target plugin to specify the dependency. 使用目标插件的 getName() 值来指定依赖。
      • If any plugin listed here is not found, your plugin will fail to load at startup. 如果此处列出的任何插件未找到，你的插件将无法在启动时加载。
      • If multiple plugins list each other in depend, creating a network with no individual plugin does not list another plugin in the network, all plugins in that network will fail. 如果多个插件在 depend 中互相列出，形成一个没有任何单独插件不在该网络中列出其他插件的网络，则该网络中的所有插件都会加载失败。
      • depend must be in must be in YAML list format. * depend 必须为 YAML 列表格式。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named depend. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 depend。

      Example: 

      depend:
- OnePlugin
- AnotherPlugin
      返回:
      immutable list of the plugin's dependencies 插件依赖的不可变列表

    • getSoftDepend

      public List<String> getSoftDepend()
      Gives a list of other plugins that the plugin requires for full functionality. The PluginManager will make best effort to treat all entries here as if they were a dependency, but will never fail because of one of these entries. 给出此插件实现完整功能所需的其他插件列表。PluginManager 会尽最大努力将此处的所有条目当作 依赖 对待，但绝不会因为这些条目之一而失败。
      • Use the value in the getName() of the target plugin to specify the dependency. 使用目标插件的 getName() 值来指定依赖。
      • When an unresolvable plugin is listed, it will be ignored and does not affect load order. 当列出了无法解析的插件时，它将被忽略，不影响加载顺序。
      • When a circular dependency occurs (a network of plugins depending or soft-dependending each other), it will arbitrarily choose a plugin that can be resolved when ignoring soft-dependencies. 当发生循环依赖（一组插件相互依赖或软依赖）时，将任意选择一个在忽略软依赖时可以解析的插件。
      • softdepend must be in YAML list format. * softdepend 必须为 YAML 列表格式。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named softdepend. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 softdepend。

      Example: 

      softdepend: [OnePlugin, AnotherPlugin]
      返回:
      immutable list of the plugin's preferred dependencies 插件首选依赖的不可变列表

    • getLoadBefore

      public List<String> getLoadBefore()
      Gets the list of plugins that should consider this plugin a soft-dependency. 获取应将此插件视为软依赖的插件列表。
      • Use the value in the getName() of the target plugin to specify the dependency. 使用目标插件的 getName() 值来指定依赖。
      • The plugin should load before any other plugins listed here. 此插件应在此处列出的任何其他插件之前加载。
      • Specifying another plugin here is strictly equivalent to having the specified plugin's getSoftDepend() include this plugin. 在此处指定另一个插件，严格等价于让被指定插件的 getSoftDepend() 包含 此插件。
      • loadbefore must be in YAML list format. * loadbefore 必须为 YAML 列表格式。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named loadbefore. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 loadbefore。

      Example: 

      loadbefore:
- OnePlugin
- AnotherPlugin
      返回:
      immutable list of plugins that should consider this plugin a 应将此插件视为软依赖的插件的不可变列表 soft-dependency

    • getPrefix

      public String getPrefix()
      Gives the token to prefix plugin-specific logging messages with. 给出用于为插件专属日志消息添加前缀的令牌。
      • This includes all messages using Plugin.getLogger(). 包括使用 Plugin.getLogger() 的所有消息。
      • If not specified, the server uses the plugin's name. 若未指定，服务器将使用插件的 名称。
      • This should clearly indicate what plugin is being logged. 应能清楚地表明正在记录的是哪个插件。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named prefix. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 prefix。

      Example:

      prefix: ex-why-zee
      返回:
      the prefixed logging token, or null if not specified 带前缀的日志令牌，若未指定则为 null

    • getCommands

      public Map<String,Map<String,Object>> getCommands()
      Gives the map of command-name to command-properties. Each entry in this map corresponds to a single command and the respective values are the properties of the command. Each property, with the exception of aliases, can be defined at runtime using methods in PluginCommand and are defined here only as a convenience. 给出命令名到命令属性的映射。此映射中的每个条目对应一个命令，相应的值是该命令的属性。每个属性（别名 aliases 除外）都可以在运行时使用 PluginCommand 中的方法定义，此处定义仅为方便起见。 命令的友好描述。既可用于文档目的，也可用于游戏内帮助。 注意：命令别名中不能包含冒号。 使用该命令所需的 Permission 名称。无此权限的用户将收到指定消息（见下文 Command.setPermissionMessage(String)），或未定义特定消息时的标准消息。若无此权限节点，则不会调用任何 CommandExecutor 或 TabCompleter。 当 PluginCommand.setExecutor(CommandExecutor) 的 返回 false 时，此消息会显示给玩家。<command> 是一个宏，会被替换为所输入的命令。
      The command section's description
      Node Method Type Description Example
      description Command.setDescription(String) String A user-friendly description for a command. It is useful for documentation purposes as well as in-game help.
      description: Set yourself on fire
      aliases Command.setAliases(List) String or List of strings Alternative command names, with special usefulness for commands that are already registered. Aliases are not effective when defined at runtime, so the plugin description file is the only way to have them properly defined. 命令的备用名称，对已被注册的命令特别有用。别名在运行时定义不会生效，因此插件描述文件是正确定义别名的唯一途径。

      Note: Command aliases may not have a colon in them.

      		Single alias format: 
      aliases: combust_me
      or multiple alias format: 
      aliases: [combust_me, combustMe]
      permission Command.setPermission(String) String The name of the Permission required to use the command. A user without the permission will receive the specified message (see below), or a standard one if no specific message is defined. Without the permission node, no CommandExecutor or TabCompleter will be called.
      permission: inferno.flagrate
      permission-message Command.setPermissionMessage(String) String
      • Displayed to a player that attempts to use a command, but does not have the required permission. See above. 向尝试使用命令但没有所需权限的玩家显示。参见上文的 Command.getPermission()。
      • <permission> is a macro that is replaced with the permission node required to use the command. <permission> 是一个宏，会被替换为使用该命令所需的权限节点。
      • Using empty quotes is a valid way to indicate nothing should be displayed to a player. 使用空引号是表示不向玩家显示任何内容的有效方式。 
      permission-message: You do not have /<permission>
      usage Command.setUsage(String) String This message is displayed to a player when the PluginCommand.setExecutor(CommandExecutor) returns false. <command> is a macro that is replaced the command issued.
      usage: Syntax error! Perhaps you meant /<command> PlayerName?
      It is worth noting that to use a colon in a yaml, like `usage: Usage: /god [player]', you need to surround the message with double-quote: 值得注意的是，若要在 yaml 中使用冒号，例如 `usage: Usage: /god [player]'，你需要用双引号包围该消息： 
      usage: "Usage: /god [player]"
      The commands are structured as a hiearchy of nested mappings. The primary (top-level, no intendentation) node is `commands', while each individual command name is indented, indicating it maps to some value (in our case, the properties of the table above). 命令以嵌套映射的层级结构组织。主（顶层、无缩进）节点为 `commands'，而每个具体的命令名都有缩进，表示它映射到某个值（在本例中即上表所列属性）。

      Here is an example bringing together the piecemeal examples above, as well as few more definitions:

       下面这个示例将上述零散示例以及更多定义汇总在一起：
commands:
  flagrate:
    description: Set yourself on fire.
    aliases: [combust_me, combustMe]
    permission: inferno.flagrate
    permission-message: You do not have /<permission>
    usage: Syntax error! Perhaps you meant /<command> PlayerName?
  burningdeaths:
    description: List how many times you have died by fire.
    aliases:
    - burning_deaths
    - burningDeaths
    permission: inferno.burningdeaths
    usage: |
      /<command> [player]
      Example: /<command> - see how many times you have burned to death
      Example: /<command> CaptainIce - see how many times CaptainIce has burned to death
  # The next command has no description, aliases, etc. defined, but is still valid
  # Having an empty declaration is useful for defining the description, permission, and messages from a configuration dynamically
  apocalypse:
      Note: Command names may not have a colon in their name. 注意：命令名称中不能包含冒号。
      返回:
      the commands this plugin will register 此插件将注册的命令

    • getPermissions

      public List<Permission> getPermissions()
      Gives the list of permissions the plugin will register at runtime, immediately proceding enabling. The format for defining permissions is a map from permission name to properties. To represent a map without any specific property, empty curly-braces ( {} ) may be used (as a null value is not accepted, unlike the commands above). 给出插件在启用后立即注册的权限列表。定义权限的格式是从权限名到属性的映射。要表示一个不含任何具体属性的映射，可以使用空花括号（{}）（因为不接受 null 值，这一点与上文的 命令不同）。

      A list of optional properties for permissions: 权限的可选属性列表：

      该权限用途的纯文本（用户友好）描述。
      The permission section's description
      Node Description Example
      description Plaintext (user-friendly) description of what the permission is for.
      description: Allows you to set yourself on fire
      default The default state for the permission, as defined by Permission.getDefault(). If not defined, it will be set to the value of getPermissionDefault(). 该权限的默认状态，由 Permission.getDefault() 定义。若未定义，将取 getPermissionDefault() 的值。

      For reference:

        * 供参考：
      • true - Represents a positive assignment to permissibles. true - 表示对 可许可对象的肯定赋予。
      • false - Represents no assignment to permissibles. false - 表示不对 可许可对象进行赋予。
      • op - Represents a positive assignment to operator permissibles. op - 表示对 管理员可许可对象的肯定赋予。
      • notop - Represents a positive assignment to non-operator permissibiles. notop - 表示对 非管理员可许可对象的肯定赋予。 
      default: true
      children Allows other permissions to be set as a relation to the parent permission. When a parent permissions is assigned, child permissions are respectively assigned as well. 允许将其他权限设为父权限的关联。当父权限被赋予时，子权限也会相应地被赋予。
      • When a parent permission is assigned negatively, child permissions are assigned based on an inversion of their association. 当父权限被否定赋予时，子权限将基于其关联的取反来赋予。
      • When a parent permission is assigned positively, child permissions are assigned based on their association. 当父权限被肯定赋予时，子权限将基于其关联来赋予。

      Child permissions may be defined in a number of ways:

        子权限可以通过多种方式定义：
      • Children may be defined as a list of names. Using a list will treat all children associated positively to their parent. 子权限可以定义为名称列表。使用列表会将所有子权限视为与其父权限正向关联。
      • Children may be defined as a map. Each permission name maps to either a boolean (representing the association), or a nested permission definition (just as another permission). Using a nested definition treats the child as a positive association. 子权限可以定义为一个映射。每个权限名映射到一个布尔值（表示关联），或一个嵌套的权限定义（就像另一个权限一样）。使用嵌套定义会将子权限视为正向关联。
      • A nested permission definition must be a map of these same properties. To define a valid nested permission without defining any specific property, empty curly-braces ( {} ) must be used. 嵌套权限定义必须是具有相同属性的映射。要定义一个不含任何具体属性的有效嵌套权限，必须使用空花括号（{}）。
      • A nested permission may carry it's own nested permissions as children, as they may also have nested permissions, and so forth. There is no direct limit to how deep the permission tree is defined. 嵌套权限可以拥有自己的嵌套权限作为子权限，它们又可以再嵌套，依此类推。权限树的定义深度没有直接限制。
      		As a list: 
      children: [inferno.flagrate, inferno.burningdeaths]
      Or as a mapping: 或使用映射形式： 
      children:
  inferno.flagrate: true
  inferno.burningdeaths: true
      An additional example showing basic nested values can be seen here. 展示基本嵌套值的另一个示例可参见此处。
      The permissions are structured as a hiearchy of nested mappings. The primary (top-level, no intendentation) node is `permissions', while each individual permission name is indented, indicating it maps to some value (in our case, the properties of the table above). 权限以嵌套映射的层级结构组织。主（顶层、无缩进）节点为 `permissions'，而每个具体的权限名都有缩进，表示它映射到某个值（在本例中即上表所列属性）。

      Here is an example using some of the properties:

       下面是使用部分属性的示例：
permissions:
  inferno.*:
    description: Gives access to all Inferno commands
    children:
      inferno.flagrate: true
      inferno.burningdeaths: true
  inferno.flagate:
    description: Allows you to ignite yourself
    default: true
  inferno.burningdeaths:
    description: Allows you to see how many times you have burned to death
    default: true
      Another example, with nested definitions, can be found here. 另一个使用嵌套定义的示例可参见此处。
      返回:
      the permissions this plugin will register 此插件将注册的权限

    • getPermissionDefault

      public PermissionDefault getPermissionDefault()
      Gives the default default state of 给出为插件注册的权限的默认状态。 permissions registered for the plugin.
      • If not specified, it will be PermissionDefault.OP. 若未指定，将为 PermissionDefault.OP。
      • It is matched using PermissionDefault.getByName(String) 使用 PermissionDefault.getByName(String) 进行匹配
      • It only affects permissions that do not define the default node. 它只影响未定义 default 节点的权限。
      • It may be any value in PermissionDefault. 可以是 PermissionDefault 中的任何值。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named default-permission. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 default-permission。

      Example:

      default-permission: NOT_OP
      返回:
      the default value for the plugin's permissions 插件权限的默认值

    • getAwareness

      public Set<PluginAwareness> getAwareness()
      Gives a set of every PluginAwareness for a plugin. An awareness dictates something that a plugin developer acknowledges when the plugin is compiled. Some implementions may define extra awarenesses that are not included in the API. Any unrecognized awareness (one unsupported or in a future version) will cause a dummy object to be created instead of failing. 给出插件的所有 PluginAwareness 集合。知晓项（awareness）表示插件开发者在该插件编译时所确认的内容。某些实现可能会定义 API 之外的额外知晓项。任何无法识别的知晓项（不受支持或来自未来版本）都会创建一个哑对象，而不会导致失败。
      • Currently only supports the enumerated values in PluginAwareness.Flags. 目前仅支持 PluginAwareness.Flags 中的枚举值。
      • Each awareness starts the identifier with bang-at (!@). 每个知晓项的标识符都以 bang-at（!@）开头。
      • Unrecognized (future / unimplemented) entries are quietly replaced by a generic object that implements PluginAwareness. 无法识别的（未来/未实现）条目会被一个实现了 PluginAwareness 的通用对象悄悄替换。
      • A type of awareness must be defined by the runtime and acknowledged by the API, effectively discluding any derived type from any plugin's classpath. 知晓项的类型必须由运行时定义并得到 API 的承认，这实际上排除了来自任何插件 classpath 的派生类型。
      • awareness must be in YAML list format. * awareness 必须为 YAML 列表格式。

      In the plugin.yml, this entry is named awareness. 在 plugin.yml 中，此条目名为 awareness。

      Example:

      awareness:
- !@UTF8

      Note: Although unknown versions of some future awareness are gracefully substituted, previous versions of Bukkit (ones prior to the first implementation of awareness) will fail to load a plugin that defines any awareness. 注意：尽管某些未来知晓项的未知版本会被优雅地替换，但旧版本的 Bukkit（早于知晓项首次实现的版本）将无法加载定义了任何知晓项的插件。

      返回:
      a set containing every awareness for the plugin 包含该插件所有知晓项的集合

    • getFullName

      public String getFullName()
      Returns the name of a plugin, including the version. This method is provided for convenience; it uses the getName() and getVersion() entries. 返回插件的名称及其版本。提供此方法是为了方便；它使用 getName() 和 getVersion() 条目。
      返回:
      a descriptive name of the plugin and respective version 插件及其版本的描述性名称
